steps.title: Evidence Fusion service: port fuseEvidence/learnWeights + 5 modality extractors into a real, callable service
steps.task: Create services/evidence-fusion-service.js exporting extractTranscriptEvidence, extractTimingEvidence, extractTonalityEvidence, extractHistoryEvidence, extractFaceBodyEvidence, fuseEvidence, and learnWeights -- a deterministic port of the already-proven prototype scripts/prototype-evidence-fusion-v2.mjs (30/30 tests). No AI/model call anywhere in this file. Do not include the prototype's self-test auto-execution code or its dotenv/assert imports -- this is a production service module, not a CLI script.
non_goals: face/body/tonality signal collection (V3 Perception, separate mission) -- this ports fusion logic only
any AI/model call -- this must remain deterministic like the proven prototype
wiring into any live product surface (V3/V4/V5's job)
redesigning the state taxonomy or scoring arithmetic
